components.name: Toast
components.description:
Figma Toast-Message (1579:13276): Corner-Radius/2XLarge surface with Effect/Popover, padding Medium/Large,
gap Medium; the Body groups the Title/Caption stack (gap 3XSmall) with the action (gap XSmall).
Subtle is the Popover surface with a 1px OUTSIDE Border/Popover/Subtle stroke.

props.name: status
props.deprecated: Use type: success → positive, error → negative (warning and info are the same).

props.name: icon
props.description: `true` (default) shows the type's icon, `false` hides it; an icon name or a node replaces it.

props.name: action
props.type: { label: ReactNode; onClick?: () => void; keepOpen?: boolean }
props.description:
Figma Actions: one Small button. Pressing it runs `onClick`, then dismisses the toast through `onClose` (which
 useToast and ToastStack provide), so Undo or View never leaves a stale toast. `keepOpen: true` leaves it open,
 e.g. when the action updates this toast in place; calling dismiss(id) in `onClick` as well is harmless.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the close control. Default: the locale's “Dismiss”.

components.name: ToastStack
components.description:
Toast queue with motion: a new toast rises in from the screen edge while its row opens (Slow, emphasized); a leaving
toast fades and shrinks in place (Fast), then its row closes (Base) so the others slide over. Fixed stacks portal into
a shared layer in the ZenPortal container; aria-live is on each Toast.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description:
Called when a toast times out, its close button is pressed or its action runs (unless `action.keepOpen`); remove it
 from `toasts`. It may be called again for an id already removed (an action that dismisses itself): ignore that.

props.name: duration
props.description:
Default auto-dismiss (ms). Toasts with an action get +3s. Each toast counts down from when it appears; timers
 pause while the stack is hovered or focused.

props.name: max
props.description: Most toasts shown at once; older ones are dismissed.

props.name: inline
props.description: Render in place (e.g. inside a demo card) instead of the fixed viewport layer.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of every toast's close button (a toast's own `closeLabel` wins). Default: the locale's “Dismiss”.

components.name: ToastProvider
components.description:
Owns the toast queue and renders one ToastStack. ZenProvider already includes it (outermost provider), so apps
only call useToast(); render ToastProvider yourself only outside a ZenProvider.

props.name: duration
props.description: Default auto-dismiss in ms (toasts with an action get +3s).

props.name: max
props.description: Most toasts on screen at once.

types.ToastItem: interface ToastItem extends Omit<ToastProps, "onClose" | "className"> { id: string | number; duration?: number | null; }
